text:
Anya (CS): Quick heads-up — SentinelHealth onboarding: account showing a 3x token spike after last week’s embed rollout. Need QBR-ready numbers and go/no-go for a credits top-up.
Matt (FinOps): saw that, ran forecast — at current run rate they'll hit 90% of monthly retainer in ~6 days. Quick numbers:
- current month tokens used: 18.2M
- avg daily tokens (7d): 2.6M
- projected month-end: ~78M (retainer 85M)
Devin (SE): root cause seems to be the new patient-summary prompt that triggers long generations. Can add a max_tokens cap for now.
Sophie (AE): I'll schedule an enablement session with their ML team tomorrow 10am PT. Want us to propose throttles + a short SOP.
Anya (CS): Yes please. Also need a simple slide for QBR: "cost impact, mitigation, ask" — Matt can you add the forecast table? :pray:
Matt (FinOps): on it. quick snapshot I can paste into deck:
```
Scenario | Projected tokens | Notes
Base (no change) | 78M | within retainer
With throttle (max_tokens=256) | 42M | reduces peak cost ~45%
With cache & prefix reuse | 30M | requires dev time
```
billing-bot: Alert: SentinelHealth exceeded 75% of monthly credits threshold — notification sent to billing@sentinelhealth.com :warning:
Devin (SE): I'll open a PR to add `max_tokens=256` and a safety layer to the prompt pipeline. ETA today EOD.
Sophie (AE): For the QBR, do we want to recommend a short-term top-up vs permanent plan change? I can surface options.
Anya (CS): Recommend top-up + commit to revisit after 2 weeks of throttle + caching data. That lowers renewal risk.
Matt (FinOps): I'll draft three cost options (one-pager) and share in this thread when done.
Anya (CS): Awesome. Action items: Sophie schedule enablement + customer ask; Devin PR and deploy throttle; Matt cost options; I'll prepare QBR slide. :thumbsup:
Sophie (AE): Added enablement invite, pinged their PM.
Matt (FinOps): Cost options posted — link: https://redwood.internal/docs/qbr/sentinelhealth-costs (internal)
Anya (CS): Great, thanks team. We'll run a quick 15m stand tomorrow pre-enable. :calendar:
